answer: The mechanism is per-identity proof-of-work plus a refundable stake. Each new agent identity must post a bond that stays locked for the epoch and is slashed when one operator runs many ids that misbehave, so a Sybil farm pays the stake n times before it can vote. The velvet of cheap registration disappears: minting 10,000 ids costs 10,000 stakes plus the same hash work per id, turning a tundra of free accounts into a comet of real capital at risk.
